tools.name: list_api_endpoints
tools.justification: Searches the connector's reviewed local API catalog and neither calls Telnyx account APIs nor changes state.

tools.name: get_api_endpoint_schema
tools.justification: Returns one schema from the reviewed local API catalog and cannot execute the represented endpoint.

tools.name: get_call_status
tools.justification: Reads an authenticated account's current call status without issuing a Call Control command or changing the call.

tools.name: list_call_events
tools.justification: Reads bounded, account-scoped call events and cannot modify events, calls, or account configuration.

tools.name: search_recordings
tools.justification: Reads bounded recording metadata, redacts sensitive fields, and cannot create, download, alter, or delete a recording.
